subject: whale
name: 鲸鱼
label: 跃起的座头鲸
learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One humpback whale arcing upward in three-quarter view, long pectoral flipper, distinctive throat folds limited to four broad lines and clear tail flukes.
STRICT RENDERING: Only clean pure black contour lines. All body interiors are completely blank white or transparent. Absolutely no shading, no gray tones, no washes, no feather marks or material texture. Put the complete artwork inside the center 65 percent of the canvas so every extremity has a generous blank margin.
